description: The itemised bill: every session with when it ran, how long it was billable for, and what it cost. Billing is per SECOND — activeSeconds is real wall time, never rounded up to a minute. Pass endUserId to see one of your own users, which works only if the call was started with metadata.user_id.

endUserId.description: Your own user id, from metadata.user_id

from.description: ISO timestamp. Defaults to 30 days ago.

name: list_sessions
title: List billable sessions
